sloka: तस्यागस्त्यो बहुगुणं कन्दमूलं तथौषधिम् ।शाल्यादीनि पवित्राणि भोजनार्थमकल्पयत् ।। ७.८२.३ ॥
transliteration: tasyāgastyo bahuguṇaṁ kandamūlaṁ tathauṣadhim ।śālyādīni pavitrāṇi bhojanārthamakalpayat ।। 7.82.3 ॥

translations.english: For Rama, Agastya arranged a meal consisting of excellent roots, fruits, herbs, and pure rice and other grains.
